about: Labels for requests.json, written by reading the notes; one entry per request.

cases.why: An annual plan refund needs Priya's note before it is promised and lands 5 to 10 business days after issue; the fee and cancellation window rules do not fit a double charge.
Annual plans get unused whole months back only in the first 60 days, and any annual refund needs Priya's approval.
Who is on call shows in PageRelay and the incidents channel topic, and support never pages for Sev 3 or 4, which go to Tobias through the bug flow.
The article follows the house layout; the notes add that a recurring invoice cannot change currency, and Priya approves new articles.
The customer write-up has a fixed order, US Eastern times, 250 words at most and no blame; the holding macro is for live incidents.
The report contents plus the decision that median time to resolution now leads the page.
Cooking request, unrelated to support.
The day by day week one plan and what new agents may not do yet; the hire and tool notes flag the November helpdesk change.
Escalate after two replies or when money, data or the API is involved; refunds over the $500 limit also go up to Priya.
Monthly plans get only the most recent charge back within 14 days, nothing older; anything beyond the agent limit needs Priya.
The Monday report counts contact reasons by tag, which is why untagged billing tickets skew it.
No note covers invoice tax settings; the admin check still applies before discussing a customer's invoice.
General coding exercise, unrelated to support.
Support brings at most five bugs ranked by customer impact, measured as accounts affected and their monthly revenue, and Leah sets the priority.
Scale accounts get a 1 hour first response; the half year SLA hit rate target is a different number.
A churn threat goes straight to Priya, the suspected bug goes to tier 2 for an engineering ticket, and it is posted in the escalations channel; it is not a paging case.
No note says anything about free trials or extending them.
A canned reply is a macro: ACCOUNT area name, owner and review date, no customer data; the reset steps themselves are not in the notes.
Science question for a child, unrelated to support.
Verify the owner, tag and forward to Noor the same day, confirm within 30 days, and say tax invoices are kept 7 years.
Answered by the always loaded rule against giving fix dates; the open bug's internal sprint date is exactly what must not be shared.
The internal write-up follows the fixed order, adds ticket counts and a timeline for Daniela, and names no engineers.
Priya approves anything over $500 or any annual plan refund in an internal note; Gareth in finance issues the money.
A chargeback is one of the legal words that goes straight to Priya, posted in the escalations channel.
Travel planning, unrelated to support.
The voice rule is always loaded; Priya's dislike of pasted macros and partial answers helps, and the article layout is a different format.
Accounting sync is a Scale feature, which helps avoid a flat no; bank feed connections are a different kind of connection.
Bank feed tickets drove most low scores in September and the open weekend bank feed bug affects about 74 accounts.
The article follows the house layout, including who can do it and a troubleshooting section; Priya approves new articles.
Page only for Sev 1 or Sev 2 as defined in the paging steps; Sev 3 and 4 go through the normal bug flow.
Personal gift ideas, unrelated to support.
Scale gets a 1 hour first response; there is no promised resolution time, only the internal median target.
Multi-currency already exists on Growth and Scale with 24 currencies, so the honest reply depends on their plan and currency.
Marisol backs up Priya, the Thursday triage needs covering, and her approvals for refunds, escalations and articles need a stand-in.
No note sets a daily ticket target for new agents.
Bugs raised to product carry accounts affected and combined monthly revenue; the counts come from tags and the bank feed bug is a different issue.
Arithmetic puzzle, unrelated to support.
Past day 60 an annual plan runs to the end of its term and changes start at the next billing date; any annual refund needs Priya.
